messages:
alex: heads-up — seeing p95 spike + 502/504s on rerank when QPS hits ~1200. repro steps and logs below.

jamal: can you paste the req id(s) and a minimal repro? which route/model/version?

alex: route: POST /v1/rerank (rerank-v1). observed under sustained burst ~1200 qps from a single customer. payload = ~400 candidates, top_k=50, client retries=3. quick curl: 
```bash
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" -d '{\n  \"query\": \"find best answers\",\n  \"candidates\": [\"... 400 items ...\"],\n  \"top_k\": 50\n}'
```

ingrid: 400 candidates is high — internal batch cap ~256. that will cause split/fanout and KV cache churn. any gateway logs?

alex: pasted small gateway snippet: 
```
[2026-02-10T14:12:03Z] req=zh7a 502 upstream_timeout model=rerank-v1 pool=dedicated-a
[2026-02-10T14:12:03Z] req=zh7a retry=1 backend=reranker-3 504 read_timeout
[2026-02-10T14:12:04Z] req=zh7b 502 gateway_timeout
```

jamal: were clients chunking or sending one huge call? also are they using keepalive connections?

alex: single huge call, no chunking. p95 at gateway starts ~2.8s, then jumps to 12s and we see 502s. clients then retry quickly (500ms) which amplifies load.

sre-oncall: @ingrid can you check pool in-flight counts + circuit-breaker events for that time window?

ingrid: checked: queue depth spiked to ~1200 requests, reranker-3 CPU pegged at 98%, KV cache eviction rate x3. no OOMs, but long GC pauses on one node correlate to timeouts. cb trips briefly then retries cascade.

alex: also noticed some responses had NaN or -inf scores when we trimmed frames due to timeouts — scoring code might not handle partial candidate lists gracefully.

jamal: please provide customer id and sample req ids so I can open an ops ticket and ask for temporary throttling.

alex: customer_id: cust_9f3b. sample req ids: zh7a, zh7b, zh7c. repro script (super minimal):
```python
# stress tool: send ~1200 qps with 350 candidates per request
for i in range(15000):
  send_request(cust='cust_9f3b', candidates=350)
```

ingrid: mitigation suggestions: enforce server-side max_candidates=200, return 4xx if client exceeds; add server guard to drop invalid scores and return clear error; recommend client-side chunking + exponential backoff; consider soft quota per-customer to prevent single tenant floods.

jamal: opening INC: attaching logs & repro. will request temporary route throttling for cust_9f3b and escalate to eng-runtime for hotfix. @ingrid assigned.

support-bot: Incident created -> #INC-20260210-12 (priority: P2) :thumbsup:

alex: added full log dump + dygraph of p95 to ticket. i'll include suggested client changes and sample chunker code.

ingrid: I'll prototype a quick server-side guard to detect candidate_count > 256 and respond with 400+hint. aiming to ship hotfix to canary tonight.

jamal: thanks all — keep thread updated.

alex: noted — will follow-up with customer ask to add backoff and reduce candidate_count. :memo:
